name: @hitbox/database
description: Shared database package — merged Prisma schema, migrations, and the PrismaClient singleton for the HitBox backend.

scripts.db:validate: pnpm db:merge && dotenv -e ../../../.env -- prisma validate --schema prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.db:migrate: pnpm db:merge && dotenv -e ../../../.env -- prisma migrate dev --schema prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.db:migrate:create: pnpm db:merge && dotenv -e ../../../.env -- prisma migrate dev --create-only --schema prisma/schema.prisma
